query: Virtual machines, websites and other products built on blob data all slow down or fail at once, shortly after we started rolling out a performance tweak.
Some IPv6 traffic sees heavy packet loss and added latency for about 25 minutes after an automated policy change on one router in a single city.
Every switching node on our research backbone grinds to a halt for hours and traffic barely moves after some strange messages started circulating.
Players worldwide cannot log in or open the store for two hours, with API probes timing out from over half of our test locations and packet loss rising.
Our admin web console and many management APIs return 5xx errors, and the authorization backend keeps falling over after a new frontend release and a backend update.
Object storage requests show about 20 percent errors for four hours, and mail, photos and file-sharing products built on top also get error spikes.
All of our apps and internal tools disappear from the internet, including the ones engineers need to fix it, right after a routine backbone maintenance command.
Many edge products return 401 Unauthorized for key-value reads and writes for about 35 minutes, right after a deployment tool configuration change.
A key facility in the Portland area goes offline for hours after the utility did maintenance, and a ground fault and failed breakers stop it coming back.
Applications in our busiest US hosting area cannot open new database connections overnight, then load balancer health checks fail and new virtual machines will not launch.
Newly created virtual machines, VPN tunnels and network load balancers are unreachable on their public addresses for about two hours, while existing ones are fine.
Our own website and all customer sites on one file store throw errors, scheduled tasks stop running, and recovery takes hours even though the data is mirrored.
Our main API gets a burst of 5xx errors for under two minutes, then replicas stop syncing with duplicate key errors, so we move reads to the primary.
After the new game release some players' Windows PCs refuse to start up, because the graphics content upgrade removed a startup file from the system drive.
Every web and API request fails for about 36 minutes right after a database config change made health checks to the read replicas fail.
Several managed products in Europe return errors for under two hours because the front-end load balancing layer is failing.
Virtual machines in every region lose their external connectivity for about 18 minutes, with inbound internet traffic not reaching them.
The site goes down for hours during planned switch software upgrades, with servers losing the paired network switches and a messy recovery.
A customer's entire private virtualization environment across two zones disappears after a provisioning run, and only backups held elsewhere let them recover.
Many managed products in London show elevated errors and latency for more than a day, even though they were designed to survive a single zone failing.
About 2 percent of CDN requests get generic error pages and tail latency triples, with one process stuck in a loop after a new DDoS rule.
Our payments API stops answering for roughly 15 seconds during a planned schema change that we thought was safe.
Pages show stale or inconsistent data and webhooks stop delivering for a full day after a brief connectivity blip between data centers.
